name: What is the typical cost range for under-cabinet lighting installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for under-cabinet lighting installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for under-cabinet lighting installation varies widely based on the type of lighting chosen (e.g., LED strips versus puck lights), the extent of electrical work required, and the total length of cabinets. Hardwired systems generally cost more due to labor for electrical integration. During a consultation, Hometelligent Inc. can provide a detailed estimate after assessing your specific kitchen layout and desired features.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation costs vary based on lighting type, electrical work, and cabinet length, with hardwired systems typically costing more.
